name: Debug
description: Runtime toggles for verbose logging and DevTools on new windows

commands.name: peek debug
commands.description: Toggle verbose logging (writes to <userData>/logs/main.log + renderer.log). With no argument, prints current state.

params.name: state
params.description: on | off (omit to show current state)

commands.name: peek devtools
commands.description: Toggle DevTools availability on newly-opened windows. Existing windows are unaffected. With no argument, prints current state.

params.name: state
params.description: on | off (omit to show current state)
